JOIN users AS T2 
ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id 
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' 
AND T1.AnswerCount = (SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = T2.Id)
SELECT T2.AnswerCount FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' ORDER BY T2.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.AnswerCount FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' ORDER BY T1.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.AnswerCount FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' ORDER BY T1.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.AnswerCount FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' ORDER BY T2.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.AnswerCount) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND T1.PostTypeId = 2 ORDER BY T1.AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1
